plugins.name: minecraft-modding
plugins.description: Minecraft 1.21.1 NeoForge modpack work: KubeJS 2101 scripts, mod configs, porting a pack from 1.20.1 / 1.18.2, Lost Cities biome zones, worldgen density, TPS / FPS optimization, autotests of your own mod in Gradle dev runs. Worked examples: the DeceasedCraft port and the Space Journey mod.

plugins.name: agent-workflow
plugins.description: How Claude Code works with agents and learns from its own work: model choice and briefs for subagents, error post-mortems, decision conflicts shown to the user, a session error audit with scripts, skills built from verified experience (skill-forge), a project journal with checked steps (project-journal), proving that a check can fail with mutations (test-mutations), Windows shell traps (beta), looking up prices and delivery on websites like a regular visitor (browse-like-user).

plugins.name: writing-and-scripts
plugins.description: Readable documents for people (plain language, few lists, re-checked text) and large Windows batch / cmd scripts with embedded PowerShell (menu tools, tweakers, installers).
